heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can the app handle video and images at scale?
items.answer: Yes. We use cloud storage and CDNs for fast media delivery.

items.question: How do you handle moderation?
items.answer: We include reporting tools, review queues and admin controls, with automated filters where useful.

items.question: Can I start with an MVP?
items.answer: Yes. Launching a focused first version is often the smartest route.

items.question: How long does social media app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
